actions.name: leads_import_leads
actions.summary: Upload leads from an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV sheet (Admin or Manager)
actions.description: The file is checked immediately and kept for the Admin to download; its rows are then imported in the background. `allocationMode` says who gets the leads: every Manager's presales team (ALL_TEAMS), or the Managers named in `managerIds` — each an equal share, kept to themselves (MANAGERS_ONLY) or spread across themselves and their presales team (MANAGERS_AND_TEAMS) — or the people in `customAllocations`, each with their own number of leads (CUSTOM). Poll GET /leads/imports/:id for progress and the per-row outcome.

allocationMode.description: Who gets the sheet’s leads. ALL_TEAMS: every Manager’s presales team. MANAGERS_AND_TEAMS: the Managers in `managerIds`, each sharing their part with their presales team. MANAGERS_ONLY: those Managers themselves. CUSTOM: the people and numbers in `customAllocations`. Left out, an Admin’s upload is ALL_TEAMS and a Manager’s MANAGERS_AND_TEAMS for themselves.

managerIds.description: The Managers to share the sheet with — required for MANAGERS_AND_TEAMS and MANAGERS_ONLY, not allowed with ALL_TEAMS. A Manager lists themselves to take a share. Send the field once per id (or as a JSON array).

customAllocations.description: Required for CUSTOM, not allowed otherwise: a JSON array saying how many of the sheet’s leads each person gets. An Admin may name any Manager or team member; a Manager themselves, their own team or another Manager. The numbers can’t add up to more than the sheet has rows.

collaboratorIds.description: Older clients, Managers only: other Managers who share the sheet on top of the uploader. Use `allocationMode` with `managerIds` instead — the two can’t be combined.

actions.excludedReason: file upload (chats cannot send files reliably yet)

actions.summary: Set allocation mode (ROUND_ROBIN / MANUAL), target role and allocateOnlyCheckedIn (Admin)

allocationMode.description: ROUND_ROBIN: auto-assign new leads. MANUAL: leave them NEW for an Admin.

allocationTargetRole.description: Who new leads rotate across (default MANAGER)

allocateOnlyCheckedIn.description: Only users with a CHECKED_IN attendance row today receive leads

autoReallocateLostLeads.description: Hand a lead to someone else the moment it is marked LOST (RCRM feature)

actions.summary: Automated Task Allotment settings (Admin)

actions.name: task_allotment_settings_update
actions.summary: Set batch size, look-back window, eligibility, priority and filters (Admin)

autoAllotEnabled.description: Hand callers a batch of old leads once their day’s work is done

autoAllotLookbackDays.description: Only leads that came in within this many days (default 30, rolling)

autoAllotRestDays.description: Skip leads contacted within this many days (default 2)

autoAllotIncludeLost.description: Also allot leads already marked LOST

autoAllotEligibility.description: NOT_CONNECTED: last call was NO_ANSWER. CONTACTED_OPEN: any contacted lead not converted.

autoAllotThenBy.description: Tie-breaker when two leads rank the same

actions.name: set_target
actions.summary: Set (or update) an employee's monthly target — a Manager for their direct reports, an Admin for any Manager or executive
actions.warning: This sets the person's monthly target; it replaces any target already set for that month.

actions.name: my_target
actions.summary: Caller's own target vs actual for a given month (defaults to current month)
actions.roles: any signed-in user (the service may narrow it)
examples: my target vs actual this month

actions.name: team_targets
actions.summary: Target vs actual for a month — a Manager's direct reports, or every Manager and executive for an Admin

actions.name: skip_allotted_lead
actions.summary: Skip one of today's allotted leads

id.description: the allotment's id (find it with my_allotted_leads)

actions.name: my_allotted_leads
actions.summary: Today's automatically allotted old leads
actions.description: Built on the first call of the day once the user has no untouched leads and no follow-ups due today. `workLeft` counts what still comes first; `items` is the batch, rank 1 first.
examples: which old leads did I get today?

actions.name: allotment_overview
actions.summary: Per person: today's batch progress and allotted leads converted over the look-back window (Manager: self + team)

actions.name: create_task
actions.summary: Create a personal to-do task, optionally linked to a lead with reminder offsets
actions.roles: any signed-in user (the service may narrow it)

title.example: Follow up with Rahul about the Bandra 3BHK

assignedToId.description: user id to give the task to (Managers/Admins); leave out for yourself

dueAt.description: when it's due, ISO with offset, e.g. 2026-11-05T11:00:00+05:30

leadId.description: the related lead's id (find it with find_lead)

reminderOffsetsMinutes.description: Minutes before dueAt to send a reminder. Defaults to [1440, 360] (1 day + 6 hours before) when dueAt is set and this is omitted. Pass [] for no reminders.

examples: remind me tomorrow 11 am to call Jain Hardware

exampleBody.title: Call Jain Hardware about BWP rates

reminderOffsetsMinutes.description: Minutes before dueAt to send a reminder. Defaults to [1440, 360] (1 day + 6 hours before) when dueAt is set and this is omitted. Pass [] for no reminders.
